---
title: "ColorPicker"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
source(file.path("..", "..", "shots.R"))
```

ColorPicker is a color selector supporting multiple color formats;
`input$<id>` is the colour as text.

## Basic usage

```{r basic, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE}
el_color_picker("c1", value = "#409EFF")
el_color_picker("c2")
```

## Alpha

```{r alpha, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "document.querySelector('#shot .el-color-picker__trigger').click()", shot_sel = ".el-color-dropdown", shot_wait = 1}
el_color_picker("ca", value = "rgba(19, 206, 102, 0.8)", show_alpha = TRUE)
```

## Predefined colors

```{r predefine, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE, shot_js = "document.querySelector('#shot .el-color-picker__trigger').click()", shot_sel = ".el-color-dropdown", shot_wait = 1}
el_color_picker("cp", value = "rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.68)", show_alpha = TRUE, predefine = c(
  "#ff4500", "#ff8c00", "#ffd700", "#90ee90", "#00ced1", "#1e90ff", "#c71585",
  "rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.68)", "rgb(255, 120, 0)", "hsv(51, 100, 98)"))
```

## Sizes

```{r sizes, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE}
el_color_picker("s1", value = "#409EFF")
el_color_picker("s2", value = "#409EFF", size = "medium")
el_color_picker("s3", value = "#409EFF", size = "small")
el_color_picker("s4", value = "#409EFF", size = "mini")
```

## API

```{r api, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
api_tables("color-picker")
```
